mentions.name: ReadPlusOne
mentions.description: A Spanish learning app that uses LLMs to generate stories tailored to the reader's specific vocabulary level. While reading, users tap words they don't know to add them to a spaced repetition system (SRS), and the SRS is later used to generate stories that review those words in context rather than as plain flash cards. A native iOS app built in Swift is in development.
mentions.problem: Vocabulary review with plain flash cards lacks context.
mentions.source_excerpt: To summarize it in short, it uses LLMs to generate stories at your specific vocab level. As you read you tap words you don’t know and they get added to a spaced repetition system (SRS). The SRS is then pulled from later when generating stories to help you review those words with context rather than just a flash card.
mentions.author: brandonc7
